heading: HDFC Bank Q2: Green Shoots Signal Future Growth
tldr: HDFC Bank reported a 4.7% year-on-year rise in net profit to ₹19,510 crore for Q2 FY27.
Net Interest Margin (NIM) declined to a 12-quarter low of 3.16%, partly due to FCNR (B) deposits.
Despite margin pressure, the bank's core operating profit showed growth.
Asset quality improved, with Gross Non-Performing Assets (NPA) at 1.11% and Net NPA at 0.37%.
A strategic shift towards higher-yielding loans is expected to support margin recovery in upcoming quarters.
caption:
Ever wonder how big banks are doing? HDFC Bank just shared its latest report, and it's good news for its future! Their profits went up, and they're lending smarter. While some things looked a bit low this time, the bank is making changes that should help it grow even more. This means good things for its health in the long run. Want to know more?
